notes.title: Launch Day Hotfixes V2
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44830192/e73df2e5ba28b4eccf48ec1793a5a3a9f9ab0804.png[/img]

A few more small changes based on player feedback:

- Fixed a bug where the story could get stuck on early quests

- Slightly increased the level cap (now players who are stuck can grind a bit more if needed)

- "Muzzle" item has been doubled in strength (this should make it easier to handle wild Entities in the early stages of the game)

notes.title: Launch Day Hotfixes
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44830192/e73df2e5ba28b4eccf48ec1793a5a3a9f9ab0804.png[/img]

Some changes based on early feedback:

- Fixed a bug where available levels would disappear from the map after completing Pink Peak.

- Earning gold is now a bit easier: golden paths are more rewarding, and during long rests you can once again "look around," even if the level has already been completed.
